lines.en: Your party is waiting. Let's go!
lines.zh: 雷克斯在此,你的队伍在等你!

tagline.en: Gather your AI party. Adventure awaits.

rationale: Rex's loud, loyal voice delivers the hook verbatim with a short rallying add-on, then a cut to him drawing his blade leads into a warm end card inviting players to recruit AI companions and install.
